data.name: Emmelina
data.gender_notes: Emmelina is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Emmelina derives from 'Ammah' which means 'mother' and 'El' meaning 'God'. Therefore, Emmelina translates to 'graceful one of God', or 'mother of God' in English. In Christian tradition, this name is a reminder of Mary, the mother of Jesus, and the grace she bestows upon us all. The name Emmelina carries the meaning “Graceful one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Emmelina usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes the maternal love and grace of God, and the blessings and nurturing care He provides to His children.
data.etymology: Emmelina belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Emmelina total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
